parts.label: Part I
parts.title: Before the code
parts.intro: What zram needs from a codec, how LZ compression and Huffman codes work, what makes code slow on a CPU, and the seqlz format on one page. Read this part first if you have never written a compressor or kernel code.

parts.label: Part II
parts.title: The code, line by line
parts.intro: The code of src/, file by file, with a short note next to each block, and under a note the details when you want them: why, a worked example, what it was measured at. The map comes first, then the files in the order of the contents.

parts.label: Part III
parts.title: The whole picture
parts.intro: One page followed through every function, and the design decisions with the measurements behind them.
